title: Samuel the Nagid
episode: Samuel HaNagid - A Prince of Jews - Extra History
description: Samuel ibn Naghrillah, a Jewish poet and scholar, rose to be chief minister of Zirid Granada in the 1000s and led its armies in battle. The Realejo, below the Alhambra, was the city’s Jewish quarter.

title: Columbus gets his ships
episode: 17th April 1492: Christopher Columbus gets support for his first voyage from Ferdinand and Isabella
description: On April 17, 1492, three months after taking Granada, Isabella and Ferdinand signed an agreement at their camp in nearby Santa Fe to back Columbus’s voyage. A monument in this square shows him presenting his plan to the queen.

title: Mariana Pineda
episode: Mariana Pineda, a heroine in defense of freedom
description: Mariana Pineda, a young widow, was executed in Granada in 1831 after a flag embroidered for the liberal cause was found in her house. Lorca’s first successful play told her story. Her statue stands in this square.
